operating_notes.text: Capital work-in-progress stood at ₹140.02 Cr at 31 March 2026 against ₹47.29 Cr a year earlier.
FY26 capex was ₹99.51 Cr, funded by a ₹48.73 Cr rights issue and ₹39.29 Cr of net new borrowings.
Kilitch Estro Biotech PLC operates a Cephalosporin manufacturing plant in East Africa, contributing ₹47.57 Cr turnover in FY26.
Pen facility to manufacture liquid injectable vials, lyophilised injectable vials, ophthalmic eye drops, and GLP-1 therapies, targeting EU GMP and PIC/S accreditations.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹89.6 Cr (+46.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹14.52 Cr (+39.6% YoY).
Mukund Mehta (Managing Director and Promoter) declared no encumbrance on Kilitch Drugs’ shares for FY2026 on 4 April 2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Kilitch Drugs approved converting ₹57 Cr debt into equity and divesting 100% of Kilitch Estro Biotech to HarmeeCare for $12.86M.
Kilitch Drugs released a press statement on the US$14M divestment of its Ethiopian subsidiary Kilitch Estro Biotech to HarmeeCare Pharmaceuticals.
